account: It is day 0, about 09:02. I came from home to town hall, read the appointment book, and returned it to the appointments chest at 08:57. Today’s schedule is correspondence in the office, a 10:00 plaza market walk, lunch at home at noon, town accounts at 13:00, tea with the neighbour at an east-bank dockside cottage at 15:00, office at 16:30, and home at 19:00. I have asked the secretary about correspondence, town news, and which cottage hosts tea; those questions remain unanswered. The secretary has just said the appointments chest is empty and asked whether I have the book. This conflicts with my successful return of it, but may simply reflect an earlier check; I have no evidence of theft or deception. Several townsfolk have passed near town hall, with nothing demonstrably unusual about their movements. I have a general feeling that something is happening without my knowledge, but have not yet observed a secret gathering, identified anyone involved, or learned its purpose. I should clarify the book’s return with the secretary and keep my market appointment while listening for reliable news.
